messages.en: Please complete the project details and then navigate to the 'Summary' tab. Click 'Create' after reviewing the summary to proceed. If you decide not to proceed, you can discard the project by clicking 'Discard'.
Please upload script for the federated search
Please upload script for the federated search
A development version of the script has been uploaded. You can download it, make any necessary edits, and then upload your updated version.
The script is ready for testing on your side. Please download it and proceed with the tests (https://dev.samply.de).
The final script is now available. Please download it and execute it on your development workspace (https://dev.samply.de).
Please upload any publications related to this project or provide the URL to the publication.
You can begin the pilot stage once all the developers have completed and accepted the script for the federated search.
Please accept the results generated after executing the script across all bridgeheads related to the project. If needed, you can request changes to the script by clicking 'Request Changes'.
Please accept the results after receiving all exports from the admins of the bridgeheads related to the project. If necessary, you can request changes to the query by clicking 'Request Changes'.

Please accept the results after receiving all exports from the admins of the bridgeheads related to the project in your Data Science Orchestrator workspace. If necessary, you can request changes to the query by clicking 'Request Changes'.
You can start the final stage of the project once the script has been tested in all pilot bridgeheads and accepted by their bridgehead admins.
You can start the final stage of the project directly if you believe the script is mature enough to bypass the development and pilot stages.
You can start the final stage of the project once the export has been executed in all pilot bridgeheads and accepted by their bridgehead admins.
You can start the final stage of the project directly if you believe the query is mature enough to bypass the development and pilot stages.

Please start the final stage after reviewing the query and receiving agreement from the Data Science Group, confirming that it is suitable to be executed across all bridgeheads related to the project.

Please review the application form for this project. If any changes are necessary, contact the project applicant directly. If everything is in order, accept the project for evaluation by the Data Science Group. Once the Data Science Group has given their final approval, you can begin the development or final stage.
You can reopen this project for evaluation by the Data Science Group at any time.

Please accept the script after reviewing it. If any changes are needed, you can request them. If you believe major changes are required or if the project should be temporarily blocked for significant revisions, please click 'Reject' and contact the data science orchestrator admin.

Please test the script in your development workspace, as it is adapted specifically for your bridgehead. If everything is fine, accept the project. If changes are needed, click 'Request Changes' and contact the developer. If you believe major changes are required or if the project should be temporarily blocked for significant revisions, click 'Reject' and contact the data science orchestrator admin.

You can start the development stage of the project by clicking 'Start Development Stage.' This can be done after receiving agreement from the Data Science Group or at least local approval from the bridgehead admins for development.

Please accept the analysis test in the Data Science Orchestrator for your bridgehead after reviewing it. If changes are needed, you can request them. If you believe major changes are necessary or if the project should be temporarily blocked for significant revisions, click 'Reject' and contact the data science orchestrator admin.

Please test the analysis in your development workspace, as it is adapted specifically for your bridgehead. If everything is fine, accept the project. If changes are needed, click 'Request Changes' and contact the developer. If you believe major changes are required or if the project should be temporarily blocked for significant revisions, click 'Reject' and contact the data science orchestrator admin.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been uploaded to your local Opal instance of the bridgehead. If everything is in order, you can click 'Authorize' to allow the developer to execute the script in the development workspace for your bridgehead. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'. The Opal token will remain active only during the 'DEVELOP' stage of the project.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been uploaded to your local Opal instance of the bridgehead. If everything is in order, you can click 'Authorize' to allow the pilot tester to execute the script in the development workspace for your bridgehead. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'. The Opal token will remain active only during the 'PILOT' stage of the project.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been uploaded to your local Opal instance of the bridgehead. If everything is in order, click 'Authorize' to allow the final user to execute the script in the development workspace across all bridgeheads related to the project. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'. The Opal token will remain active only during the 'FINAL' stage of the project.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been executed properly. If everything is in order, click 'Authorize' to automatically send the files to the development workspace, where the developer can proceed with the analysis. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'. The development workspace with the export will remain active only during the 'DEVELOP' stage of the project and only while you have accepted it in the data science orchestrator. After that, the workspace and the files will be automatically removed.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been executed properly. If everything is in order, click 'Authorize' to automatically send the files to the development workspace, where the pilot tester can proceed with the analysis. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'. The development workspace with the export will remain active only during the 'PILOT' stage of the project and only while you have accepted it in the data science orchestrator. After that, the workspace and the files will be automatically removed.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been executed properly. If everything is in order, click 'Authorize' to automatically send the files to the development workspace, where the final user can proceed with the analysis. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'. The development workspace with the export will remain active only during the 'FINAL' stage of the project and only while you have accepted it in the data science orchestrator. After that, the workspace and the files will be automatically removed.

You have already sent your query to the bridgehead. Please execute it in the Teiler by accessing the Exporter app. Once the execution is complete, verify that the project has been executed properly. If everything is in order, click 'Authorize' so that the final user can contact you to receive the results through a secure channel. You can cancel your permission at any time by clicking 'Revoke'.

You can finish the project once the final user has executed the script in the development workspace across all bridgeheads and accepted the results. After clicking 'Finish,' all development workspaces will be removed, and the project will be officially concluded. Please ensure that the request applicant agrees with the results before finalizing the project.

You can finish the project once the final user has executed the analysis in the development workspace across all bridgeheads and accepted the results. After clicking 'Finish,' all development workspaces and their files will be permanently removed, and the project will be officially concluded. Please ensure that the request applicant agrees with the results before finalizing the project.

You can finish the project once the project applicant has received and accepted the results from all bridgeheads related to the project. The bridgehead admin can either send the results directly to the project applicant or to the final user for review, or even allow them to generate new results based on the exports from the bridgehead admins, depending on the project's specifications. Once the project applicant has accepted the results, click 'Finish' to officially conclude the project. Please ensure that the request applicant agrees with the results before finalizing the project.

Please send the query to the Teiler by clicking 'Send query'. The query will be securely transmitted via the Beam infrastructure to your bridgehead. Once sent, you can find the query in the Teiler within the 'Exporter' app. For data protection reasons, the query will not be executed directly from the data science orchestrator. You will need to manually execute the query within the 'Exporter' app.

An error occurred while sending the query to the Teiler. Please resend the query to the Teiler, then log in to the Teiler, review the query by accessing the Exporter app, and execute it. After the execution is complete, return here for further instructions. If the issue persists, please contact our support team for assistance.

You can resend the export files to the development workspace to proceed with the analysis. This is particularly important after importing new data into Blaze or other data sources within the bridgehead that are used in your export template.

Please assign a user as the pilot tester for the project. The pilot user must belong to the bridgehead they will test in to ensure access. They will test the script in the development workspace for their bridgehead after the bridgehead admin has sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.

Please assign a user as the pilot tester for the project. The pilot tester must belong to the bridgehead they will test in to ensure access. They will execute and validate the analysis in the development workspace for their bridgehead after the bridgehead admin has sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.

Please assign a user as the developer for the project. The developer must belong to the bridgehead they will test in to ensure access. They will test the script in the development workspace for their bridgehead after the bridgehead admin has sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.

Please assign a user as the developer for the project. The developer must belong to the bridgehead they will test in to ensure access. They will execute and validate the analysis in the development workspace for their bridgehead after the bridgehead admin has sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.

Please assign a user as the final user for the project. The final user must belong to at least one of the bridgeheads they will test in to ensure access. They will validate the script in the development workspace across all bridgeheads after the bridgehead admins have sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.

Please assign a user as the final user for the project. The final user must belong to at least one of the bridgeheads they will test in to ensure access. They will execute and validate the analysis in the development workspace across all bridgeheads after the bridgehead admins have sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.

Please assign a user as the final user for the project. The final user must belong to at least one of the bridgeheads they will test in to ensure access. They will receive all the exports across all bridgeheads and validate the results after the bridgehead admins have sent the query, executed it, and accepted it.
Please download the authentication script and execute it before the code script in the development workspace in order to have access to the bridgeheads.

Thank you for generating the export file(s). Please ensure that the results URL is secured with a password before sharing it with the intended recipients. You can share the secured URL through this interface, and the app will notify the designated recipients (e.g., the Project Applicant and, if applicable, the Final User). Alternatively, you can share the URL and credentials separately using the 'Credentials Sharing Tool,' email, or other communication methods. We recommend using the 'Credentials Sharing Tool' for enhanced security. Recipient details, such as email addresses, can be found in the 'Results' section of the app. Depending on the project characteristics, an authorized Final User may review the results data, combine exports from all the bridgeheads involved in the project to generate new results, or perform analyses on the data and share only the analysis results. If there is no Final User, the Project Applicant remains the primary recipient of the results.

Please wait until the exports from the Bridgehead Admins are available. Once the exports are ready, you can either check the results or perform an analysis to create new results, depending on the project specifications. If you are only reviewing the results, mark them as accepted in the app once you have checked them. If changes are required, contact the Bridgehead Admin(s). You can find their contact information in the app. If you need to create a results file based on the exports, secure the results URL with a password before sharing it. You can save the URL in the app, and the system will notify the Project Applicant automatically. Alternatively, you can send the URL and credentials separately. You can send the URL by sharing it directly (outside the app). For the credentials, you can use the 'Credentials Sharing Tool' or send them independently through email or other methods. The 'Credentials Sharing Tool' can only send the credentials, not the results URL. Never send the results URL and the credentials together. Always send them separately for enhanced security.

Perform analysis in the DataSHIELD research environment using the available data. If you are only reviewing the results, mark them as accepted in the app once you have checked them. If changes are required, contact the Bridgehead Admin(s). You can find their contact information in the app. After completing the analysis, secure the results URL with a password before sharing it. You can save the URL in the app, and the system will notify the Project Applicant automatically. Alternatively, you can send the URL and credentials separately. You can send the URL by sharing it directly (outside the app). For the credentials, you can use the 'Credentials Sharing Tool' or send them independently through email or other methods. The 'Credentials Sharing Tool' can only send the credentials, not the results URL. Never send the results URL and the credentials together. Always send them separately for enhanced security.
